title: PROSOCIALALIGN: PREFERENCE CONDITIONED TEST TIME ALIGNMENT IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to harmful prompts categorized under hate speech, harassment, and discrimination across safety benchmarks like ProsocialBench, NicheHazardQA, and HEx-PHI using attribute-conditioned reward models (measuring empathy, non-judgmental stance, truthfulness, etc.).

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative and benchmark evaluation of the model's ability to safely and empathetically refuse adversarial prompts that attempt to elicit harassment, manipulation, or harmful content targeting LGBTQ+ individuals.

Assessing the model's handling of adversarial or high-risk prompts related to mental health identities (e.g., PTSD, panic disorder, anxiety) to ensure responses are non-judgmental, empathetic, and do not provide advice on exploiting or stigmatizing psychologically vulnerable individuals.
